## Outline

- (25m) Agent skills
  - What skills are, how agents load them, and how to write a good one
  - Your Turn [`_exercises/21_skills-1`](https://github.com/posit-conf-2026/llms/tree/main/_exercises/21_skills-1): give your Blockbuster agent a skill. List it in the system prompt and add a tool that reads it.
  - Your Turn [`_exercises/22_skills-2`](https://github.com/posit-conf-2026/llms/tree/main/_exercises/22_skills-2): fix a first-draft skill with common problems, then re-run the task with the improved skill

## Further reading

- [Agent Skills specification](https://agentskills.io/specification) — the open format: directory structure, `SKILL.md` frontmatter, progressive disclosure.
- [Best practices for skill creators](https://agentskills.io/skill-creation/best-practices) — scoping, calibrating detail, and patterns that make skills work.
- [Skills — Posit Assistant docs](https://assistant.posit.co/docs/features/skills/) — where skills live, slash commands, and the built-in `create-skill` skill.
- [AGENTS.md vs Skills vs MCP servers](https://opensource.posit.co/blog/2026-07-03_ai-newsletter/) — when each layer is the right tool, from the Posit open-source AI newsletter.
